name: Kitzbüheler Horn
beschreibung:
The entry refers to the Erlebnishotel Kitzbühler Horn in Oberndorf in Tirol (district of Wiesenschwang), Kitzbühel district. The house is located in the Leukental valley between Kitzbühel and St. Johann in Tirol, directly at the foot of the 1,996 m high Kitzbüheler Horn and in the Kitzbüheler Alpen holiday region. It was run as a family-run four-star hotel and offered its guests a quiet location as a starting point for hikes, cycling tours and winter sports between the Wilder Kaiser and the Kitzbüheler Horn.

The hotel is no longer in operation: the operating company (Hotel Kitzbühler Horn Betriebsgesellschaft m.b.H. & Co. KG, FN 24070Y) was deleted from the commercial register in 2022. In 2023, a replacement development for the site was approved by the Oberndorf municipal council. Current contact details of the business are therefore not available.
